files.name: motion-prompt-226.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Bubble chart" (バブルチャート), one of the names in "Diagrams and charts for slides".
Motion Prompt #226

What it is: Circle size shows a third number
What the sample shows: Five semi-transparent circles of different sizes grow one by one on L-shaped axes; only the largest is dark blue.
Spec:
- Axes: the same L-shaped axes and grid lines as #225 Scatter plot; they stay for the whole cycle
- Circles: five, radius 14–44 px, semi-transparent fill (opacity 0.5; the largest is dark blue at 0.42) with a 2.5 px outline in the same color
- Motion: from 0.45 s, 0.24 s apart, each grows over 0.5 s with a small overshoot (ease-out-back)
- Unlike #225 Scatter plot: only a few points, and the circle size carries a third number
- End: the axes and grid stay; only the data fades out from 4.15 s to 4.55 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
When to use it: To compare three numbers at once: across, up and size.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/226.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/diagram.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
